commitResults.messageTitle: Rename Duke chatbot and implement Level-0 greeting
Level-4 deadline and event task types
Refactor tasks into separate OOP components
Organize source files into aravii package
Add JUnit tests for task behavior
Bundle JavaFX dependencies in application JAR
commitResults.messageBody:
The default Gradle JAR task packages project classes but not runtime
dependencies. Without JavaFX libraries, the generated application JAR
cannot run on machines that do not already have JavaFX installed.

Bundle the runtime dependencies and exclude duplicate entries so Gradle
produces a self-contained JAR while preserving the Launcher entry point.

Task objects and task lists rely on non-null internal values.

Invalid state can fail later in formatting or storage, making its source
harder to identify.

Add assertions for required task fields and for task-list entries. Cover
these invariants with regression tests so test runs check them.

Assertions document programmer assumptions without changing user-facing
input validation.

The CLI and GUI duplicate parsing and date handling.
This makes behavior drift likely when one interface changes.

Move shared command execution into CommandHandler so both interfaces use
it. Keep presentation concerns in each interface while ensuring task
operations and validation produce the same results throughout.

This reduces duplication and makes future command changes easier to
review and test.

commitResults.messageTitle: TaskList: use streams for task formatting
commitResults.messageBody:
TaskList formats each task with explicit index-based loops, which makes
the collection transformations more verbose than necessary.

Use indexed streams to preserve task order and numbering while filtering
matching tasks. Collect formatted entries with newline separators so the
existing output remains unchanged.

Add tests for ordering, numbering, and matching behavior.
Bring the latest merged increments into the Streams branch before its pull request.

Tasks appear in insertion order, making larger lists harder to scan.

Add a case-insensitive sort command through the shared command handler
so both interfaces present the same ordered tasks. Keep the existing
display format and cover sorted output and help text with tests.

commitResults.messageTitle: Fix task modeling and protect saved data
commitResults.messageBody:
Malformed task descriptions can crash command handling, impossible dates
are normalized silently, and failed loads can overwrite existing saves.
Task dates are also stored as strings rather than the required objects.

Introduce task subclasses with typed dates and strict validation.
Separate parsing, collection management, storage, and presentation, and
share the autosave lifecycle between the CLI and GUI. Preserve damaged
saves and report storage failures without silently losing in-memory
changes.

Add regression coverage for every command, invalid inputs, legacy saves,
save failures, and restart behavior. Enforce the missing Javadoc rules
and retain locale-independent search, stable sorting, and the CLI
banner.

commitResults.messageTitle: Package native JARs and verify reproducible builds
commitResults.messageBody:
The fat JAR includes Intel Mac libraries, so it cannot supply JavaFX on
Apple Silicon. Builds also require a separately installed Gradle
version, and CI does not check tests' style or package the application.

Add an isolated Apple Silicon JAR alongside the course's cross-platform
x64 JAR, select host-native dependencies for Gradle runs, and add the
checksum-pinned Gradle wrapper. Run tests, both style checks, packaging,
and Javadocs in CI under Java 25.

Replace template setup text with commands, platform selection, and save
recovery guidance so users can build and run the verified application.

Integrate the task-modeling, input-validation, storage-safety, and
packaging fixes found by the Week 1-5 audit. Keep the repair work on its
own branch so the completion point is visible without rewriting the
published project history.

commitResults.messageTitle: Improve error handling and automated test coverage
commitResults.messageBody:
Replace assertion-only validation with explicit argument checks so invalid
inputs produce predictable user-facing errors. Add command, parser, storage,
and task-list tests for the new validation paths.

commitResults.messageTitle: Document Arav II setup and task commands
commitResults.messageBody:
The user guide contains starter placeholders and no launch instructions.
It lacks guidance on running the app and recovering saved data.

New users need setup steps and command examples to use the application
without reading its source code.

Replace the template with Java 25 setup instructions, platform-specific
launch commands, examples for every command, and data recovery guidance.
Add a full-window screenshot showing sample tasks.

Keep these instructions in the product guide so users can find setup,
usage, and troubleshooting information in one place.
